basics.name: JOSHUA D
basics.label: Systems & Embedded Software Engineer
basics.sublabel: B.E. Electronics & Communication Engineering | Automotive & Full-Stack
basics.summary: Electronics and Communication Engineer with proven hands-on expertise across low-level systems, automotive cockpit domain controllers (CAN bus, AAOS), custom Linux kernels, and creative full-stack WebGL architectures. Recognized winner of the 7chats Messenger Bug Bounty contest for authentication security research. Passionate about building zero-latency, high-reliability embedded systems and interactive digital platforms.

education.degree: Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Electronics & Communication Engineering

education.institution: St. Joseph's English Medium High School

highlights: Architecting performant, accessible web interfaces and modular component systems utilizing React 19, TypeScript, and modern styling libraries.
Engineered reusable data visualization and filtering grids capable of client-side multi-column sorting and low-latency aggregation.
Refactored state management workflows and asset delivery pipelines, reducing initial bundle weight and improving Core Web Vitals across production modules.
Collaborated in an Agile development environment with code reviews, strict Git rebasing, and automated CI/CD deployment checks.
Engineered Cockpit Domain Controller (Luxoft CDC) prototypes integrating CAN 2.0B protocols to manage Electronic Control Units (ECUs) at 8,000+ frames/sec.
Integrated Vehicle Hardware Abstraction Layer (VHAL) property services on Android Automotive OS (AAOS) for real-time instrument cluster telemetry.
Conducted board-level diagnostics, bootloader unlocking, memory tracing via procfs, and custom Linux kernel compilation for target hardware.
Discovered and responsibly disclosed an authentication bypass vulnerability within the 7chats Messenger client; officially awarded Bug Bounty Winner title.
Conducted APK binary reverse engineering using JADX, Frida instrumentation, and Burp Suite proxy interceptors to inspect token validation flows.
